CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)

   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
